changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwactiveingredients AS SELECT ai.id, ai.name, ai.drug_class_id, ai.atc_code, ai.otc, ai.has_synonyms, ai.antimicrobial, ai.high_alert, ai.abortive_medication, ai.labor_inducing_med, ai.is_controlled, ai.controlled, ai.has_black_box_warning, ai.black_box_warning, ai."is_look-alike-sound-alike", ai.created_by, ai.created_date, ai.last_modified_by, ai.last_modified_date, ai.is_active, ai.toxicity_maximum_dose, ai.toxicity_maximum_dose_per_unit, ai.toxicity_details, ai.mechanism_of_action, ai.pharma_absorption, ai.pharma_route_of_elimination, ai.pharma_volume_of_distribution, ai.pharma_half_life, ai.pharma_protein_binding, ai.pharma_clearance, ai.pharma_metabolism, ai.pregnancy_category, ai.pregnancy_notes, ai.lactation_risk, ai.lactation_risk_notes, ai.dose_adjustment_renal, ai.dose_adj_renal_one, ai.dose_adj_renal_two, ai.dose_adj_renal_three, ai.dose_adj_renal_four, ai.dose_adjustment_hepatic, ai.dose_adj_pug_a, ai.dose_adj_pug_b, ai.dose_adj_pug_c FROM public.active_ingredients ai;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwactiveingredients TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwactiveingredients FROM report_user;
